media.title: Rozmowa / Conversation — audio reference
media.description: Kaper’s earliest extant composition was written in Warsaw and survives in manuscript – insight into Kaper’s early compositional style before his commercial career began. Score-to-MIDI rendering
media.altText: Audio rendering by Iwona Lindstedt of “Rozmowa” / “Conversation”.
media.rightsNote: Recording/rendering layer cleared: audio rendered by Iwona Lindstedt from her own notation/transcription. No third-party commercial recording is used.
media.publicCaption: Audio rendering created by Iwona Lindstedt from her own notated transcription/edition of Bronisław Kaper’s early composition “Rozmowa” / “Conversation,” preserved in the Bronislaw Kaper Papers.
